story.body: You continued Saturday's descent and did not finish the ground. The glass was not written.

title: Wrote that the king is come down and looks at the ground

participation.context: Entered the sentences, the sentence he heard, and the room he has not written.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a rate heard at a stall, and not a sum read off a door

story.body: You entered threepence and the loaf. You copied the three sentences. You set down six pound and the jig, and you did not price the house. The looking-glass is not on the sheet. The room is not written.
